context_mapping.translation: The chart is specifically compatible with institution-based research in which data, models, writing, forecasting, papers, grants and collaboration turn advanced training into public career standing and income.
context_mapping.limit: This supports the academic research mechanism; it cannot by itself determine tenure, a specific university, grant amount or publication outcome.

family_kinship_cards.inference: Family roots and parental resources are tied to practical security, education, skills, documents and personal money; support is more likely to be expressed through concrete arrangements than through an unstructured emotional flow.
family_kinship_cards.counter_test: The chart does not establish whether parents are wealthy, conflictual or continuously supportive; occupation, asset and transfer history are required.

evidence: 3rd ruler Mercury in 2nd and strong in Virgo
family_kinship_cards.inference: Siblings and close relatives are linked to study, technical skill, documents, practical help and money/value decisions; sibling interaction may be useful and task-oriented, but details of number, age and gender remain unknown.
family_kinship_cards.counter_test: No concrete sibling event has been supplied, so the chart cannot distinguish actual sibling support from a close cousin or peer substitute.

evidence: 10th ruler Mars in 3rd opposite 9th ruler Saturn in 9th
family_kinship_cards.inference: Parental authority and family decisions are more likely to be experienced through education, mobility, institutions, communication and practical responsibility than through a simple parental-conflict signature.
family_kinship_cards.counter_test: The Mars/Saturn opposition is not proof of parents fighting; it may manifest through academic or institutional constraints instead.

insight_cards.rule: The 1st and 2nd houses are strongly connected; the chart's self-direction, skills and value system are direct carriers of income.
insight_cards.inference: Money is built through personal capability, analysis, communication and ownership of a skill or product, not through passive dependence alone.
insight_cards.counter_test: Venus is in Virgo and the night chart places pressure on ease of financial delivery; income may require correction, service and repeatable process.

insight_cards.rule: Career is carried through communication, documents, training and institutions, while Mars-Saturn opposition creates a pressure between immediate execution and formal rules.
insight_cards.inference: The major career question is not only what work is done, but which institution, contract, credential or partnership authorizes it.
insight_cards.counter_test: A single job title cannot represent the whole career; exact employment history is needed to choose between communication, institutional and partnership manifestations.

insight_cards.rule: Partners and collaborators carry both creative/romantic and shared-resource responsibilities; Saturn places legal, distance, education or institutional conditions on commitment.
insight_cards.inference: Relationship and partnership decisions can alter financial exposure and long-term direction; agreements need explicit boundaries and time horizon.
insight_cards.counter_test: Jupiter in the 7th can bring support, but its retrograde/air-sign condition does not guarantee stable partnership or effortless shared money.

insight_cards.rule: Daily work, health routines, education and professional qualification are joined by the same Saturn/Jupiter/Mars chain.
insight_cards.inference: Progress is achieved through sustained training and institutional participation; overloading the work-study-health system creates delays or forced resets.
insight_cards.counter_test: This is a structural risk pattern, not a diagnosis or a guarantee of illness.
